signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The $49 tier lacks 4 of 10 features in the $129 tier and includes a zero allowance.

signals.label: Vendor age & track record

signals.label: Discount size

trials.claim: Central dashboard for scheduling, publishing and analytics across 12+ platforms
trials.claimQuote: Schedule, publish, analyze, and grow social media presence across 12+ platforms from one dashboard
trials.reasoning: A review confirms publishing, analytics and other functions are combined in one tool, and the vendor lists 12 supported platforms; the narrow X link-post cap and personal Facebook limitation do not negate the central dashboard.

exhibits.quote: I purchased License Tier 2, but it only allows 20 link posts per month on X (Twitter).
exhibits.argument: The quote shows publishing to X from the dashboard is capped at 20 link posts per month, undermining unlimited 12+ platform scheduling.

exhibits.quote: While it would be nice to post to a personal Facebook account, I suppose it’s because
exhibits.argument: The quote shows Facebook publishing does not cover personal accounts, limiting the claimed across-platform dashboard.

exhibits.quote: Having publishing, social listening, automation, analytics, and a unified inbox all in one tool has a lot of potential and could make it a great option for agencies and teams managing multiple brands.
exhibits.argument: The quote confirms publishing, analytics and inbox are combined in one tool as the dashboard claim states.

exhibits.quote: SocialBu supports X (Twitter), Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram, Google Business Profile, YouTube, Reddit, Pinterest, Mastodon, Threads, TikTok, and Bluesky.
exhibits.argument: The vendor lists 12 distinct platforms, supporting the 12+ platforms part of the claim.

trials.claim: Manage, publish and track performance across 12+ social media platforms
trials.claimQuote: SocialBu lets you manage, publish, and track what's landing across 12+ social media platforms.
trials.reasoning: Reviews report Reddit accounts being banned after use and accounts disconnecting constantly requiring reconnection, materially limiting management across platforms, while the defense only generically mentions managing accounts and lists platforms without showing reliable performance tracking.

exhibits.quote: Update: 3 uses of this product for 3 different clients got all 3 reddit accounts banned.
exhibits.argument: The quote shows managing Reddit through the tool resulted in bans, contradicting safe management across 12+ platforms.

exhibits.quote: the accounts disconnect all the time, and you have to reconnect them constantly
exhibits.argument: The quote shows connected accounts do not stay managed in one place, undermining reliable cross-platform management.

exhibits.quote: Learn how to plan, publish, and manage your accounts with SocialBu.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states users can plan, publish and manage accounts with SocialBu.

exhibits.quote: SocialBu supports X (Twitter), Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram, Google Business Profile, YouTube, Reddit, Pinterest, Mastodon, Threads, TikTok, and Bluesky.
exhibits.argument: The vendor lists 12 distinct platforms, supporting the 12+ platforms part of the claim.

trials.claim: Compose and schedule posts for 12+ networks from one place
trials.claimQuote: Compose and schedule posts for 12+ networks, including LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and X—from one place
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes creating posts for multiple connected accounts and choosing publishing times or queues, and lists all the named networks among 12 platforms; the X link-post cap and shared Instagram import issue are narrow limits that do not negate composing and scheduling from one place.

exhibits.quote: I purchased License Tier 2, but it only allows 20 link posts per month on X (Twitter).
exhibits.argument: The quote shows scheduling posts for X is severely limited, contradicting compose-and-schedule for 12+ networks from one place.

exhibits.quote: none of the Instagram accounts shared with me through Meta came over.
exhibits.argument: The quote shows Instagram accounts accessible via Meta did not transfer, undermining scheduling for listed networks including Instagram.

exhibits.quote: Create posts for multiple connected accounts, customize network-specific options, choose a publishing time, or add content to a queue.
exhibits.argument: The quote confirms composing and scheduling posts for multiple accounts from one workflow.

exhibits.quote: SocialBu supports X (Twitter), Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram, Google Business Profile, YouTube, Reddit, Pinterest, Mastodon, Threads, TikTok, and Bluesky.
exhibits.argument: The list includes LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube and X, supporting the named networks part.

the accounts disconnect all the time, and you have to reconnect them constantly

themes.summary: Many buyers say the scheduler works well, is easy to use, and handles content reliably.

hits.quote: It does what I need without being cluttered with a bunch of bloated features I'll never use.
I haven't had to re-authorize any accounts yet nor have I encountered any bugs in the software.

themes.summary: Several buyers praise the one-time payment as straightforward and good value versus subscriptions.

hits.quote: No unnecessary complexity, no recurring subscription, just a straightforward way to keep content flowing.

themes.summary: One buyer says the founder was extremely responsive to feedback.

hits.quote: The founder has been extremely responsive.
